description: This file defines a mock class 'GstDispatcherThreadFactoryMock' for testing purposes, which implements the 'IGstDispatcherThreadFactory' interface. It uses Google Mock to mock the 'createGstDispatcherThread' method, which creates instances of 'IGstDispatcherThread'. The file is part of the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace and is used for unit testing components related to GStreamer dispatcher threads.
